holdable.description: Can be picked up and carried.

conspicuous.description: Others see it when someone carries it.

sharp.description: Has an edge or a point.

door.description: Opens and closes. Closed, it is in the way.

solid.description: In the way: nobody walks through it.

notice_board.description: A board people pin notes to.

fragile.description: Shatters when something hits it or it hits something.

wet.description: Soaked, so it doesn't catch fire.

health.description: How much it can take. A person has 1.

capacity.description: Holds other items, like a chest or basket.

stock.description: Something that runs out, like a wheat field.

perHour.description: How much grows back in a sim-hour.

damage.description: Health one hit takes, before strength.

hitChance.description: Chance to hit someone as nimble.

stimulus.description: What a hit sends to what it hits.

hitChance.description: Chance to hit someone as nimble.

breaks_into.description: What it turns into when it breaks.

breaks_loudly.description: Makes a noise when it breaks.

loudness.description: How far the noise carries, in tiles.

lockable.description: A lock can be fitted to it.

fitted_lock.description: Has a lock fitted, so it can be locked with a key.

lockId.description: Which lock: a key opens the lock with the same id.

lock.description: A lock that can be fitted to something.

lockId.description: Which lock: a key opens the lock with the same id.

key.description: Opens the lock with the same id.

lockId.description: Which lock: a key opens the lock with the same id.

locked.description: Locked: it won't open and nobody can see or reach inside.

mines.description: Breaks rock and ore out of the ground.

rotten.description: Gone bad: eating it can make you sick.

water_source.description: Water can be drawn from it with a bucket.

minable.description: Gives this when mined with a pickaxe.

diggable.description: Gives this when dug with a shovel.

gatherable.description: Gives this when gathered by hand.

crop.description: Gives this when harvested by hand.

fishable.description: Gives this when fished with a rod. Never runs out.

choppable.description: Felled with an axe in one go, leaving something behind.

depletes_into.description: What it becomes when its stock runs out.

turns_into.description: Becomes something else after a while: grows, ripens or spoils.

comes_in.description: The container left over when it is used up.

flock.description: Live animals kept there, like hens in a coop.

perHour.description: How many are added in a sim-hour.
